children: AMMAN — Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources Saleh Kharabsheh on Sunday reviewed progress in implementing the Economic Modernisation Vision (EMV) priorities for the energy and mining sectors during October.

Kharabsheh chaired a meeting with the ministry’s vision liaison officers to review follow-up reports, assess progress on listed projects and check compliance with established timelines, according to a ministry statement.

The minister stressed the importance of achieving the vision’s targets and coordinating with relevant entities to implement priorities within set timeframes, noting that the energy sector is a key pillar of the national economy.
He also highlighted the private sector’s role in implementing vision projects, attracting investment and supporting economic growth.
The liaison officers presented progress reports, confirming that projects in both sectors were proceeding according to schedule.

Energy sector initiatives include expanding electricity grid access through the Fils Al Reef programme, conducting energy audits, advancing oil and gas projects, improving energy efficiency and developing power generation capacity.
Mining sector priorities include gold exploration at Jabal Mubarak, the national mineral resources exploration programme and the investor single-window initiative.
